title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the walkable streets of Madison, NJ, just steps from the Drew University campus, featuring local favorites for dining, shopping, and student life.

cards.title: Main Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Madison Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this historic corridor to find student favorites like Bagel Chateau and Shanghai Jazz, just a five-minute stroll from the campus gates.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial artery of Madison, lined with diverse eateries and local boutiques.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Street is described as a haven for foodies with an array of cafes and restaurants like Bagel Chateau and Shanghai Jazz.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7; business hours vary.

cards.title: Waverly Place
cards.subtitle: Historic Downtown Block
cards.notes: Visit this block to see the Madison Millennium Clock and grab a coffee at Forum Coffee or a treat at Crowley's Cupcakes.
cards.short_summary: A picturesque downtown block home to the town's landmark clock and several popular student cafes.
cards.evidence_claim: Waverly Place is home to the Madison Millennium Clock, Forum Coffee, and Crowley's Cupcakes.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Public street; landmark clock is visible at all times.

cards.title: Kings Road
cards.subtitle: Transit and Bakery Corridor
cards.notes: Follow this road from the Madison Train Station to campus, stopping at Baba Bakery or Sunday Motor Co. for a quick bite.
cards.short_summary: A key connector between the NJ Transit station and campus, featuring popular bakeries and cafes.
cards.evidence_claim: Kings Road connects the train station to campus and features Baba Bakery and Sunday Motor Co.
cards.access_notes: Public road; primary walking route for students using the train.

cards.title: Lincoln Place
cards.subtitle: Coffee and Pizza Block
cards.notes: Head here for a caffeine fix at Bad Ass Coffee of Hawaii or a slice of pizza at Romanelli's, located just off the main drag.
cards.short_summary: A short side street known for its coffee shop and local pizza parlor.
cards.evidence_claim: Lincoln Place is the location for Bad Ass Coffee of Hawaii and Romanelli's Pizza.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University

cards.title: Green Village Road
cards.subtitle: Specialty Shop Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this street to find Dewey's Comic City and The Chatham Bookseller, perfect for browsing between classes.
cards.short_summary: A street featuring unique specialty shops including a comic book store and a used bookstore.
cards.evidence_claim: Green Village Road is home to Dewey's Comic City and The Chatham Bookseller.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Public street; shops typically open mid-morning to early evening.

cards.title: Central Avenue
cards.subtitle: Local Dining Block
cards.notes: Stop by Nicky's Firehouse Restaurant & Pizza for a casual meal in a firehouse-themed setting on this downtown block.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street featuring local favorites like Nicky's Firehouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Nicky's Firehouse Restaurant & Pizza is located at 15 Central Avenue.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University

cards.title: Prospect Street
cards.subtitle: Tavern and Dining Block
cards.notes: Check out Prospect Tavern for a classic beef and ale experience, a long-standing fixture of the Madison dining scene.
cards.short_summary: A short street home to the Prospect Tavern, a popular local dining spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Prospect Tavern Beef & Ale is located at 14 Prospect Street.
cards.access_notes: Public street; tavern is under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: Deli and Grill Corridor
cards.notes: Visit C&J's Deli or Grillera for a variety of lunch options on this street that borders the downtown area.
cards.short_summary: A street featuring local delis and Mediterranean-style grills.
cards.evidence_claim: C&J's Deli and Grillera are listed as favorite Madison eateries on Park Avenue.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Public street; businesses typically open for lunch and dinner.

cards.title: Cook Plaza
cards.subtitle: Cafe and Boutique Block
cards.notes: Stop by Butter and Jam for a cozy cafe experience in this small plaza tucked just off Main Street.
cards.short_summary: A small commercial plaza featuring local cafes and boutique services.
cards.evidence_claim: Butter and Jam is located at 30 Cook Plaza.
cards.source_title: Discover Madison – Your Home Beyond the Forest - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible plaza; business hours vary.

cards.title: Elmer Street
cards.subtitle: Comfort Food Block
cards.notes: Grab a meal at Mama B's Grill, known for its Italian comfort food and welcoming atmosphere on this quiet side street.
cards.short_summary: A side street featuring local comfort food favorites like Mama B's Grill.
cards.evidence_claim: Mama B's Grill is located at 6 Elmer Street in Madison.
cards.access_notes: Public street; grill is closed on Sundays.
